blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. treated United States President Donald Trump and his delegation to Jollibee, describing the popular Filipino fast-food chain as a “taste of Manila.” Marcos welcomed Trump at Malacañan Palace on Wednesday during his brief state visit before the two leaders departed for Shenzhen, China, that afternoon to attend the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting. During their exchange, Marcos shared that he had personally asked his staff to arrange the Jollibee food delivery on Tuesday night, knowing that Trump was pressed for time because of his back-to-back engagements for the 49th Association of […]...
